summary: Architecture gates pinning one transcript renderer and one block injector across every prompt builder.
reason: Tests only, no runtime change. #220 shipped ContextBlock/assemble/render_messages and wired one prompt builder of six; these gates measure the remaining five as strict xfails so each conversion turns a named row green (#292). Also adds the whole-turn framing check that the existing prefill tests structurally cannot perform: they read build_prefill()[1], so <tag_message> has never been looked at.
